pairs.target: dìèrtiān xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi zǒu dào běi gōng fāng shí , zhǐfèng lǐ hái liú zhe tànbǐ de hēi huī .
pairs.english: On the second afternoon, when Tavi reached the north workshop, black charcoal-pencil dust still lingered between his fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天下午，塔维走到北工坊时，指缝里还留着炭笔的黑灰。

pairs.target: shàngwǔ huà zhíxiàn , tā zǒng bǎ chǐzi àn dé tàijǐn , nuókāi yǐhòu , zhǐ shàng chúle xiàn , háiyǒu bàngè shǒuzhǎng .
pairs.english: Drawing straight lines that morning, he kept pressing the ruler too hard; after moving it away, he had left half a palm on the paper as well as the lines.
pairs.hanzi: 上午画直线，他总把尺子按得太紧，挪开以后，纸上除了线，还有半个手掌。

pairs.target: ménkǒu de shuǐlún yǐjīng tíng le .
pairs.english: The waterwheel by the door had already stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 门口的水轮已经停了。

pairs.target: yìmíng juàn zhe xiùzǐ de nǚrén dūn zài lúnzhóu páng , wǎng yóukǒng lǐ sāi miánxiàn .
pairs.english: A woman with rolled-up sleeves crouched beside the axle, stuffing cotton thread into an oil hole.
pairs.hanzi: 一名卷着袖子的女人蹲在轮轴旁，往油孔里塞棉线。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn nài lěi zài bu zài , tā méiyǒu qǐshēn , zhī cháo lǐmiàn tái le tái xiàbā .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether Nerai was there. Without getting up, she simply raised her chin toward the interior.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问奈蕾在不在，她没有起身，只朝里面抬了抬下巴。

pairs.target: " bié cǎi mén hòu de tóngguǎn . "
pairs.english: “Don't step on the copper pipe behind the door.”
pairs.hanzi: “别踩门后的铜管。”

pairs.target: nà jié guǎnzǐ héng zài dìshàng , yìtóu lián zhe chāikāi de dēngzuò .
pairs.english: That length of pipe lay across the floor, one end connected to a dismantled lamp base.
pairs.hanzi: 那截管子横在地上，一头连着拆开的灯座。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kuà guòqù , kànjiàn nài lěi zuòzài chuāng xià , yòng xīgài dǐngzhù yígè píxiāng , zhèng gēn xiāng kòu jiàojìn .
pairs.english: Tavi stepped over it and saw Nerai sitting beneath the window, bracing a leather case with her knee and struggling with its clasp.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跨过去，看见奈蕾坐在窗下，用膝盖顶住一个皮箱，正跟箱扣较劲。

pairs.target: tā yě yǒu dǎbùkāi de dōngxī . zhè ràng tā zài ménbiān duō kàn le yíhuìer .
pairs.english: There were things even she couldn't open. That kept him watching from the doorway a little longer.
pairs.hanzi: 她也有打不开的东西。这让他在门边多看了一会儿。

pairs.target: " lái bāngmáng . ànzhù zhèlǐ . "
pairs.english: “Come help. Press down here.”
pairs.hanzi: “来帮忙。按住这里。”

pairs.target: tā zhàozhe tā zhǐ de wèizhì yā xià xiāng gài .
pairs.english: He pressed the lid down where she pointed.
pairs.hanzi: 他照着她指的位置压下箱盖。

pairs.target: nài lěi bāndòng kòu shé , xiāngzǐ zǒngsuàn hé shàng , lǐmiàn què xiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Nerai levered the clasp tongue; the case finally closed, but something made a noise inside.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾扳动扣舌，箱子总算合上，里面却响了一声。

pairs.target: liǎng rén dōu méi dòng . " xīwàng shì sháozǐ . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: Neither of them moved. “Hopefully that was a spoon,” she said.
pairs.hanzi:
两人都没动。
“希望是勺子。”她说。

pairs.target: chóngxīn dǎkāi yǐhòu , duàn de shì yìzhī mùgān bǐ .
pairs.english: When they reopened it, the broken thing turned out to be a wooden pen.
pairs.hanzi: 重新打开以后，断的是一支木杆笔。

pairs.target: nài lěi wàng zhe liǎngjié bǐ , mà le yíjù , bǎ tāmen gē dào chuāngtáishàng .
pairs.english: Nerai stared at the two pieces, swore, and set them on the windowsill.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾望着两截笔，骂了一句，把它们搁到窗台上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào chū le shēng . tā kàn le tā yìyǎn , yě xiào le .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed aloud. She glanced at him and laughed too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑出了声。她看了他一眼，也笑了。

pairs.target: chuāng biān bǎi zhe jǐzhǎn xiè le zhàozǐ de dēng .
pairs.english: Several lamps with their shades removed stood by the window.
pairs.hanzi: 窗边摆着几盏卸了罩子的灯。

pairs.target: xì tóngguǎn cóng dēngzuò xià chuān rù , báisè de wǎngdài guà zài zhōngyāng , zhǐyǒu mǔzhǐ cháng , kànzhe xiàng yìzhī méi fèng wán de xiǎo wàzi .
pairs.english: A thin copper pipe entered from beneath the base; a white mesh bag hung in the middle, only a thumb long, looking like an unfinished little sock.
pairs.hanzi: 细铜管从灯座下穿入，白色的网袋挂在中央，只有拇指长，看着像一只没缝完的小袜子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ mǐlā zài fàntáng yǎng zhe liǎn de yàngzi .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered Mira's upturned face in the dining hall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起米拉在饭堂仰着脸的样子。

pairs.target: " zhè gēn chīfàn de dìfāng yòng de shì yìzhǒng ma ? "
pairs.english: “Is this the same kind they use where we eat?”
pairs.hanzi: “这跟吃饭的地方用的是一种吗？”

pairs.target: " shì . biépèng nàge bái de . "
pairs.english: “Yes. Don't touch the white part.”
pairs.hanzi: “是。别碰那个白的。”

pairs.target: shuōhuà de shì ménkǒu de nǚrén .
pairs.english: It was the woman from the doorway speaking.
pairs.hanzi: 说话的是门口的女人。

pairs.target: tā cā zhuóshǒu zǒujìn lái , jiàn tǎ wéi suōhuí shǒu , biàn bǎ yìzhī suìliè de wǎngdài lián zhe tiětuō nágěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: She came in wiping her hands and, seeing Tavi withdraw his hand, showed him a cracked mesh bag still on its iron support.
pairs.hanzi: 她擦着手走进来，见塔维缩回手，便把一只碎裂的网袋连着铁托拿给他看。

pairs.target: lièkǒu biānyuán báo dé jīhū tòuguāng .
pairs.english: The edges of the crack were so thin they were almost translucent.
pairs.hanzi: 裂口边缘薄得几乎透光。

pairs.target: " kuàng shā . shāo guò yǐhòu jiù zhème cuì .
pairs.english: “Mineral mesh. It's this brittle after firing.
pairs.hanzi: “矿纱。烧过以后就这么脆。

pairs.target: nǐ niē yíxià , jīntiān wǎnfàn jiù zài zhèér bāng wǒ sǎodì . "
pairs.english: Squeeze it and you'll spend supper here helping me sweep the floor.”
pairs.hanzi: 你捏一下，今天晚饭就在这儿帮我扫地。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ shǒubèi dào shēnhòu .
pairs.english: Tavi put his hands behind his back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把手背到身后。

pairs.target: nǚrén yòng xì tiěbàng zhǐ gěi tā kàn : ránqì zǒu tóngguǎn , kōngqì cóng dǐzuò de kǒng jìnqù , xiǎo huǒshāo rè kuàng shā , liàng de shì shā .
pairs.english: The woman pointed with a thin iron rod: fuel gas came through the copper pipe, air entered through holes in the base, and a small flame heated the mineral mesh; the mesh was what glowed.
pairs.hanzi: 女人用细铁棒指给他看：燃气走铜管，空气从底座的孔进去，小火烧热矿纱，亮的是纱。

pairs.target: fàntáng de bōlízhào zhēzhù le dǐxià nà diǎnhuǒ , yānqì lìng yǒu guǎndào yǐn dào wūwài .
pairs.english: The dining hall's glass shades hid the little flame below; fumes were led outside through a separate pipe.
pairs.hanzi: 饭堂的玻璃罩遮住了底下那点火，烟气另有管道引到屋外。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán biàn bào qǐ dēngzuò , cuī nài lěi bǎ píxiāng cóng tā de zhuōshàng nuókāi .
pairs.english: Having finished, she picked up the base and urged Nerai to move the leather case off her table.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完便抱起灯座，催奈蕾把皮箱从她的桌上挪开。

pairs.target: " suǒyǐ búshì yǒurén yìzhí zài jiè xìng ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “So nobody is borrowing properties the whole time?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “所以不是有人一直在借性？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " nǐ yào zhǎodào yuànyì yìzhí zuòzài dēng dǐxià de rén , kěyǐ dàilái . " nǚrén shuō ,
pairs.english: “If you find someone willing to sit under a lamp all the time, bring them along,” the woman said.
pairs.hanzi: “你要找到愿意一直坐在灯底下的人，可以带来。”女人说，

pairs.target: " búguò wǒ zhèlǐ bú fù fànqián . "
pairs.english: “But I don't pay for their meals here.”
pairs.hanzi: “不过我这里不付饭钱。”

pairs.target: tā zǒu hòu , nài lěi gěi píxiāng huàn le zhāng zhuōzi , cóng xiāngdǐ chōuchū yìběn qǐzhòu de cèzǐ .
pairs.english: After she left, Nerai moved the case to another table and pulled a rumpled notebook from its bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 她走后，奈蕾给皮箱换了张桌子，从箱底抽出一本起皱的册子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi shì dìtú , còujìn le cái fāxiàn , tú biān jǐmǎn le zì , yǒuxiē dìfāng hái tiēzhe biéde zhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi thought it was a map; only closer up did he discover writing crammed around the drawings, with other pieces of paper pasted in places.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为是地图，凑近了才发现，图边挤满了字，有些地方还贴着别的纸。

pairs.target: nài lěi fān dào yíyè , wèn tā xuégōng de chuáng shuì dé zěnmeyàng .
pairs.english: Nerai turned a page and asked how he was sleeping in the school's beds.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾翻到一页，问他学宫的床睡得怎么样。

pairs.target: " bǐ jiālǐ de kuān . yǒurén dǎhūlu . "
pairs.english: “Wider than at home. Someone snores.”
pairs.hanzi: “比家里的宽。有人打呼噜。”

pairs.target: " nà jiù búshì chuáng de wèntí . "
pairs.english: “Then that's not the bed's fault.”
pairs.hanzi: “那就不是床的问题。”

pairs.target: " fàn yě gòu . " tā bǔ le yíjù .
pairs.english: “There's enough food, too,” he added.
pairs.hanzi: “饭也够。”他补了一句。

pairs.target: tā diǎndiǎntóu , dītóu cházhǎo nà zhī duàn bǐ shèngxià de bǐjiān , méiyǒu jiēzhe wèn tā gōngkè .
pairs.english: She nodded and looked down for the nib left from the broken pen, without going on to ask about his lessons.
pairs.hanzi: 她点点头，低头查找那支断笔剩下的笔尖，没有接着问他功课。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn le yíhuìer , mùguāng luòdào cèzǐ de yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi stood a moment, his gaze settling on a corner of the notebook.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站了一会儿，目光落到册子的一角。

pairs.target: nàlǐ huà zhe sānshàn mén , zhōngjiān yíshàn bèi huàdiào , yòu zài pángbiān tiān le yíshàn .
pairs.english: Three doors were drawn there; the middle one was crossed out and another added beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 那里画着三扇门，中间一扇被划掉，又在旁边添了一扇。

pairs.target: " zhè shì nǎér ? " " shānxià . yígè xiējiǎo de dìfāng .
pairs.english: “Where is this?” “Below the mountains. A place to rest.
pairs.hanzi:
“这是哪儿？”
“山下。一个歇脚的地方。

pairs.target: shàng huíqù , tāmen bǎ rùkǒu gǎi le , wǒ zài hòumén qiāolebàntiān . "
pairs.english: Last time I went, they'd moved the entrance. I knocked at the back door for ages.”
pairs.hanzi: 上回去，他们把入口改了，我在后门敲了半天。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ cèzǐ zhuǎnxiàng tā . ménpáng yǒu yíchuàn xiǎozì , tā rènchū yígè " gǒu ", qíyú kàn bù míngbái .
pairs.english: She turned the notebook toward him. Beside the door was a line of tiny writing; he recognized “dog” but couldn't make out the rest.
pairs.hanzi: 她把册子转向他。门旁有一串小字，他认出一个“狗”，其余看不明白。

pairs.target: " zhè jù ne ? " " hòuyuàn yǒu gǒu , bù yǎo shúrén . "
pairs.english: “What does this line say?” “Dog in the back yard. Doesn't bite familiar people.”
pairs.hanzi:
“这句呢？”
“后院有狗，不咬熟人。”

pairs.target: " nǐ suàn shúrén ma ? " " wǒ juéde suàn . tā méi tóngyì . "
pairs.english: “Do you count as familiar?” “I thought so. It disagreed.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你算熟人吗？”
“我觉得算。它没同意。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn zhǐ shàng háiyǒu yídào dàndànde yóuyìn , ràoguò mén dǐng , xiàng yìlún wāi yuèliàng .
pairs.english: Tavi saw a faint grease mark on the page too, curving over the door like a crooked moon.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见纸上还有一道淡淡的油印，绕过门顶，像一轮歪月亮。

pairs.target: zhè bú xiàng tā jiàn guò de huò lù tú , dǎoxiàng yǒurén bǎ zǒuguò de dìfāng yìdiǎndiǎn sāijìn le kǒudài , zuòxià shí yòu yā zhòu le .
pairs.english: It was unlike the freight maps he'd seen: more as though someone had stuffed the places they'd visited into a pocket bit by bit, then crumpled them by sitting down.
pairs.hanzi: 这不像他见过的货路图，倒像有人把走过的地方一点点塞进了口袋，坐下时又压皱了。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng wèn nàxiē rén yèlǐ guān bu guānmén , huà dào le zuǐbiān , què xiān wèn le gǒu yǒu duō dà .
pairs.english: He wanted to ask whether those people shut their doors at night, but with the words on his lips he first asked how big the dog was.
pairs.hanzi: 他想问那些人夜里关不关门，话到了嘴边，却先问了狗有多大。

pairs.target: nài lěi shēnshǒu bǐ le yíxià . tā bú xìn , tā yòu bǐ dà le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Nerai held out a hand to show him. He didn't believe her, so she made it a little bigger.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾伸手比了一下。他不信，她又比大了一点。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén hǎn tā de míngzì , yào kàn píxiāng lǐ dàihuí de jiētóu .
pairs.english: Someone outside the window called her name, wanting to see the fittings she'd brought back in the case.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人喊她的名字，要看皮箱里带回的接头。

pairs.target: tā dāying zhe , ná bùbāo qǐ jīnshǔjiàn . tǎ wéi wǎng ménkǒu tuì , tā jiàozhù tā .
pairs.english: She answered and wrapped the metal parts in cloth. Tavi backed toward the doorway, but she called him back.
pairs.hanzi: 她答应着，拿布包起金属件。塔维往门口退，她叫住他。

pairs.target: " xiàzhōu zhège shíhòu zài lái . wǒ zhè jǐtiān dōu zài zhèlǐ . "
pairs.english: “Come again this time next week. I'll be here these next few days.”
pairs.hanzi: “下周这个时候再来。我这几天都在这里。”

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , tì tā bǎ zhuōbiān de xiāng gài fú wěn .
pairs.english: He nodded and held the lid steady for her beside the table.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，替她把桌边的箱盖扶稳。

pairs.target: nà zhī duàn bǐ hái tǎng zài chuāngtáishàng , tā máng zhe zhǎo bù , méiyǒu shōu .
pairs.english: The broken pen still lay on the windowsill; busy finding cloth, she hadn't put it away.
pairs.hanzi: 那支断笔还躺在窗台上，她忙着找布，没有收。

pairs.target: huí fàntáng de lùshang , tǎ wéi xiān wǎng xīyuàn rào le yìxiǎo duàn .
pairs.english: On his way back to the dining hall, Tavi first took a short detour toward the west courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 回饭堂的路上，塔维先往西院绕了一小段。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhèngzài shuǐcáo páng xǐ mùhé shàng de mò , tīngjiàn jiǎobù , táiqǐ yìzhī hēihūhū de shǒu .
pairs.english: Mira was washing ink off her wooden box by the trough; hearing footsteps, she raised a blackened hand.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉正在水槽旁洗木盒上的墨，听见脚步，抬起一只黑乎乎的手。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào dēng zěnme liàng le . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “I know how the lamps work now,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “我知道灯怎么亮了。”他说。

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu zài yīfu shàngfāng tíngzhù , méi cāxiàqù .
pairs.english: She stopped her hand above her clothes without wiping it on them.
pairs.hanzi: 她把手在衣服上方停住，没擦下去。

pairs.target: " děng wǒ xǐwán . nǐ dé cóngtóu shuō . "
pairs.english: “Wait till I'm done washing. You'll have to start at the beginning.”
pairs.hanzi: “等我洗完。你得从头说。”
